### Egypt Redeemed
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/egypt-redeemed
Passage: Isaiah 19:21
Points:
- Scripture foretells that Egypt's ancient hostility toward God and His covenant people would not endure forever.
- Isaiah prophesied that Egyptian cities would pledge allegiance to Yahweh and embrace the true faith.
- God will make Himself known to Egypt as their healer and redeemer rather than only their judge.
- Mortal enemies Egypt and Assyria will experience genuine reconciliation and worship the Lord together alongside Israel.
- This vision of united worship finds fulfillment in the gospel, which gathers all nations into Christ's church.
